definitions.explanation: A general term for any machine capable of flight, including airplanes, helicopters, and other flying vehicles. A formal and technical term compared to the everyday 飛行機.

examples.japanese: {航空機|こうくうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧。
examples.english: A factory that manufactures aircraft parts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧{航空機|こうくうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A small aircraft made an emergency landing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数百|すうひゃく}→数百：23368_suuhyaku⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{航空機|こうくうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{離着陸|りちゃくりく}→離着陸：20749_richakuriku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Several hundred aircraft take off and land at this airport every day.

notes:
A formal, inclusive term for any flying machine. Broader than ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧ (airplane), which refers specifically to fixed-wing aircraft.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {航空機|こうくうき}⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧ (aircraft industry)
- {航空機|こうくうき}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ (aircraft accident)
- ⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧{航空機|こうくうき} (small aircraft)
- {無人|むじん}{航空機|こうくうき} (unmanned aircraft, drone)

SCOPE NOTE:
{航空機|こうくうき} covers all aircraft including helicopters, gliders, and drones, while ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧ typically refers only to fixed-wing airplanes. In everyday conversation, ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧ is far more common; {航空機|こうくうき} is preferred in news reports, technical writing, and official documents.

COUNTER: ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧
